title: Result (a paper's reported number on a benchmark)

source.description: Where in the paper this number comes from, e.g. 'Table 3'

guidance.description: Guidance technique AND scale, e.g. 'cfg=1.5', 'AutoGuidance', 'guidance-interval', 'none'. Kept separate from `setting` because guidance METHOD alone moves ImageNet gFID by more than most claimed architectural wins — the comparison tables must be able to group by it.

budget.description: Training budget, e.g. '800 epochs', '7M steps', '16 epochs distillation'.

nfe.description: Number of function evaluations at sampling time (1 for one-step methods).

self_reported_baseline.description: True if this number was measured by a paper OTHER than the one that produced the method (i.e. a third-party re-measurement), which is a known source of large spread.

caveat.description: Why this number may not be comparable to its neighbours. Rendered as a visible warning on comparison tables rather than hidden in prose.
